name: @velella/ebb
description: The open almanac of software end-of-life.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('packages/mcp/node_modules/@velella', {recursive: true}); try { fs.symlinkSync('../../../..', 'packages/mcp/node_modules/@velella/ebb', 'junction'); } catch {}"
scripts.build:mcp: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('packages/mcp/node_modules/@velella', {recursive: true}); try { fs.symlinkSync('../../../..', 'packages/mcp/node_modules/@velella/ebb', 'junction'); } catch {}" && tsc -b packages/mcp/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build --silent && mkdir -p coverage && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude="dist/tests/**" --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info "dist/tests/**/*.test.js"
scripts.api: npm run build --silent && mkdir -p api && api-extractor run --local
scripts.bench: npm run build --silent && node --input-type=module -e "import { runAllBenchmarks } from './bench/run.ts'; runAllBenchmarks();"
